name: skyggeby
description: SKYGGEBY - et norsk multiplayer crime/economy-spill for nettleser

scripts.build: npm -w @skyggeby/shared run build && npm -w @skyggeby/server run build && npm -w @skyggeby/client run build
scripts.build:deploy: npm -w @skyggeby/server run prisma:generate && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @skyggeby/server run typecheck && npm -w @skyggeby/client run typecheck
scripts.setup: npm install && npm -w @skyggeby/shared run build && npm -w @skyggeby/server run prisma:generate
